description_en: Apartment for sale - Kodra e Diellit 2 Tirana residence Kodra e Diellit 2 duplex apartment 241 m² 3+1 Floor 2 €299,900 BARGAIN!! Kodra e Diellit 2, Duplex 3 +1+ 3 & veranda The apartment is located on the 2nd and 3rd floors of a 7-storey building, where the entrance to the duplex is on the 1st floor. With a total area of 241 m2, the apartment is organized: - 1st floor: 34.8 m2 area, 1 toilet and 1 storage room - 2nd floor: 84.15 m2 area, 1 living room, 1 cooking and dining kitchen, 1 bedroom, veranda 50 m2 - 3rd floor: surface 71.96 m2, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms The apartment is fully invested, offering a comfortable living. The property includes new electrical and plumbing installations, thermal and acoustic insulation, modern bathrooms with quality equipment, new tiling/flooring, as well as a multisplit air conditioning system that covers the whole the space. Orientation from the east offers fantastic views from Dajti and natural lighting. The apartment is sold partially furnished. The price is non-negotiable!
